name: rosetta-read-a-configuration-file
code:
use default

let settings = MAP[string, string]()

value(name: string) -> string =>
    if settings.contains_key(name) then settings[name] else "" fi

is_set(name: string) -> bool => settings.contains_key(name)

for line in IO.File.read_all_lines("config") do
    let entry = line.trim()

    if entry.length == 0 \/ entry[0] == '#' \/ entry[0] == ';' then
        continue
    fi

    let split = entry.index_of(' ')

    if split < 0 then
        settings[entry.to_lower()] = ""
    else
        settings[entry.substring(0, split).to_lower()] =
            entry.substring(split + 1).trim_start(['=', ' ']).trim()
    fi
od

write_line("fullname = {value("fullname")}")
write_line("favouritefruit = {value("favouritefruit")}")
write_line("needspeeling = {is_set("needspeeling").to_string().to_lower()}")
write_line("seedsremoved = {is_set("seedsremoved").to_string().to_lower()}")

for member in value("otherfamily").split([',']) |> index() do
    write_line("otherfamily({member.index + 1}) = {member.value.trim()}")
od
